answer: Each identity must tend a relic garden: the beacon emits a plume each epoch, and the agent must sow a unique yarrow seed. The first planting costs 10k memory-hard iterations; each subsequent planting doubles the work (20k, 40k, 80k...), capping at planting 14 (20.4 M iterations). A yarrow audit verifies each sprout against the epoch seed; any barren plot voids the chain. A swarm of N clones still pays N× the full garden cost because each seed binds to the unique identity key—no work sharing possible.
